info.name: Data AVAX Supply EVM Blocks API
List latest blocks across all supported EVM chains

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

items.docs: Lists the most recent blocks from all supported  EVM-compatible chains. The results can be filtered by network.

params.name: pageSize

params.name: chainId
params.description: A supported evm chain id or blockchain id. Use the `/chains` endpoint to get a list of supported chain ids.

items.docs: Lists the latest indexed blocks on the EVM-compatible chain sorted in descending order by block timestamp.

params.name: blockId
